summary: Manage SourceDAO bootstrap and public evidence through the release node kit
details: Add sourcedao check, bootstrap, status, export and validate using a digest-pinned tools container and the installed frozen bundle.
Preserve private signing journals across detached task failures and reject conflicting node operations while a ceremony runs.
Require the SourceDAO tools image and its source attestation in release manifest v8 and package the managed command module.
operator_actions: Upgrade the node kit, start mining, then run sourcedao check and sourcedao bootstrap --key-file with the frozen Bootstrap Admin key.
Observe sourcedao status --watch, then export and validate; preserve private recovery files and publish only the public exports.
Wait for the locked SourceDAO Fast run and tools image before creating the release candidate.
